O R D E R Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as per the complaint by the mother of the victim, her daughter being under 15 years of age had been abducted for illicit sex by the petitioner.

Upon trial,
the petitioner was convicted for offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code (hereinafter called as "IPG") and Sections 4 (2) & 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (hereinafter called as 'POCSO') and sentenced to undergo RI for 7 years and fine of Rs.500/-, in default of payment of fine to further undergo imprisonment for 2 months under Section 363 of the IPC, RI for 7 years and fine of Rs.500/-, in default of payment of fine to further undergo imprisonment for 2 months under Section 366 of the IPC, RI for 20 years and fine of Rs.2000/-, in default of payment of fine to further undergo imprisonment for 6 months under Section 376(3) of the IPC and Section 4(2) of the POCSO Act and RI for 20 years and fine of Rs.2000/-.

sentences.text:
in default of payment of fine to further undergo imprisonment for 6 months under Section 6 of the POCSO Act and the said order of conviction was upheld by the High Court vide the impugned order and the same has been assailed herein.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that it was a genuine love affair between the parties and a girl child was born to the so called victim and today also the petitioner wants to live with his wife, i.e., the alleged victim.
3. Learned counsel for the State submits that the victim is living with her parents and the girl child born to her has been adopted by another family at the age of five months and now she is about four years old.
4. Be that as it may, let learned counsel for the State produce the petitioner from custody before this Court as also the so called victim, who as on date has attained the age of majority, on the next date of listing.
5. List on 19.03.2026 as the first item on the Board.
(POOJA SHARMA) (KOMAL)
 AR-CUM-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
